records.text: Candace Owens sent out a dead man's switch to the Tate brothers, Dave Smith, Max Blumenthal, Tucker Carlson and others
records.speaker: Alex Jones

appearances.snippet: this is a real dead man's switch. She has sent out to the Tate brothers, Dave Smith, Max Blumenthal, Tucker (Tucker Carlson), and others

verification.notes: This statement attributes a public report to Alex Jones. His October 8, 2025 broadcast transcript says Owens sent a dead man's switch to the Tate brothers, Dave Smith, Max Blumenthal, Tucker Carlson, and others. The same broadcast includes Owens's clip describing a package sent to trusted recipients and specifically naming Max Blumenthal and Andrew Tate.

records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: that's how you know they're not a part of the government because the government always protects their own. They protected Jeffrey Epstein. If Andrew Tate and Tristan Tate were working for the government trafficking, they would be protected.

verification.notes: DOJ's own review found that the 2007 federal non-prosecution agreement for Epstein was a flawed resolution and that U.S. Attorney Alexander Acosta exercised poor judgment, supporting the narrower observation that Epstein received unusually favorable treatment. The same review found no professional misconduct or improper-factor basis, and no reviewed evidence establishes Epstein as 'the government's own.' The Tate-brothers clause is a counterfactual that cannot be tested.
